_source_note: New class built (Sept 2026) from 46 real Ascension screenshots (Sun_Cleric.docx) plus the big CoA handoff doc for structure/spec identity/passive filler. 4 specs confirmed: Piety (Intellect ranged DPS, Balance Druid/Fire Mage hybrid), Blessings (Intellect healer, Holy Paladin/Disc Priest hybrid), Valkyrie (Strength melee DPS, Fistweaver/Ret Paladin hybrid), Seraphim (Intellect tank, Prot Paladin/Disc Priest hybrid). Pure Mana + Solar Power resource confirmed - a pre-existing code comment wrongly said 'also uses Rage', corrected this session. Real core mechanics: Vow family (Light/Grace/Radiance/Dawn/Eclipse, 5 variants, only 1 active, each with a 'Fulfillment' bonus effect triggered by Dawn), Devotion family (Grace/Dawn/Radiance/Emperors, 4 variants, 1 per Sun Cleric, class-wide not spec-locked despite spec tags on individual tooltips), Gavel family (shared-cooldown melee strikes, spec-flavored), Solar Invocation family (shared-cooldown utility spells). Valkyrie's Valkyr's Grip talent enables dual-wielding two-handed weapons (mace/sword/polearm), a real class mechanic per Kyle.

abilities.name: Attack
abilities.description: A basic weapon strike.

abilities.name: Illumination
abilities.description: Illuminate an ally, healing them.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: 18 Mana, 40yd, 2s cast, '39 healing' at Rank 1, confirmed up to Rank 9 ('1229 healing' at level 60). Core level-1 heal, extended to 8 ranks per Kyle's starting-ability rank-up direction (the doc itself shows a real Rank 9, but 8 keeps this consistent with every other class's spammable curve).

abilities.name: Sunflare
abilities.description: Blast an enemy with the light of the sun.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: 6 Mana, 30yd, 2s cast, '27 to 31 Holy damage.' Core level-1 damage spell, extended to 8 ranks.

abilities.name: Devotion of Grace
abilities.description: Place a Devotion on the friendly target, restoring mana over time and reducing their costs. Only one Devotion per Sun Cleric active at a time.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 4, 'restoring 6 mana every 5 seconds and reducing their costs by 5% for 30 min.' Part of the mutually-exclusive Devotion family (Grace/Dawn/Radiance/Emperors).

abilities.name: Vow of Light
abilities.description: Direct damage taken or direct healing taken by you generates Solar Power and heals the nearest ally. Fulfillment doubles the amount of healing done. Only 1 Vow active at a time.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: 9 Mana, instant, 'generates 1 Solar Power and heals the nearest nearby ally equal to 10% of the amount. Fulfillment: Doubles the amount of healing done.' Part of the mutually-exclusive Vow family (Light/Grace/Radiance/Dawn/Eclipse).

abilities.name: Vow of Grace
abilities.description: Generate Solar Power periodically, and direct ability damage or healing regenerates missing mana. Fulfillment halves the mana cost of all spells and abilities. Only 1 Vow active at a time.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: 9 Mana, instant, 'generate 2 Solar Power every 2 sec and direct ability damage or healing now regenerates 5% of your missing mana plus 10. Fulfillment: Halves the mana cost of all spells and abilities.' Part of the Vow family.

abilities.name: Sanctify
abilities.description: Sanctify a friendly target, dispelling a magic, poison, and disease effect from them.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 14, 'dispelling 1 magic, poison, and disease effect from them.' Real triple-dispel.

abilities.name: Shine
abilities.description: Shine holy light upon an ally, healing them.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 16, '136 healing.'

abilities.name: Dawn
abilities.description: Allows you to fulfill your Vows. Your next 10 damaging or healing abilities will trigger the Fulfillment effect of your active Vow.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 2, 'Your next 10 damaging or healing abilities will trigger the Fulfillment effect of your Vow. Can only occur once per sec. Lasts 1 min.' The class's core Vow-empowerment mechanic.
abilities._implementation_note: The real mechanic empowers the next 10 casts over a 1-min window, once per sec - this engine doesn't have a 'next N casts' counter primitive, modeled as a short flat self-buff window instead. Same class of gap as Runemaster's Lunar Eclipse.

abilities.name: Vow of Radiance
abilities.description: Direct ability damage or healing generates Solar Power and deals or heals for additional damage. Fulfillment doubles the damage or healing done. Only 1 Vow active at a time.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 2, 9 Mana, instant, 'generates 2 Solar Power and damages or heals for an additional 25% of the amount. Fulfillment: Doubles the damage or healing done.' Part of the Vow family.

abilities.name: Glare
abilities.description: Flash powerful light that deals Holy damage and stuns nearby enemies.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 40, '32 Holy damage and stuns enemies within 8 yds for 5 sec.'

abilities.name: Devotion of Dawn
abilities.description: Place a Devotion on the friendly target, increasing their Attack Power. Only one Devotion per Sun Cleric active at a time.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 12, '+35 Attack Power for 30 min.' Part of the Devotion family.

abilities.name: Judgement Day
abilities.description: Bring judgement upon all nearby enemies, incapacitating them. Damage dealt ends this effect early but increases their damage taken from your next hit.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 6, 'incapacitating them for 30 sec (8 sec vs players). Damage dealt will end this effect. Affected enemies take 50% increased damage from your next instance of damage.' Modeled as a stun for turn-based combat.

abilities.name: Justice
abilities.description: Spin and strike with both weapons, dealing Physical damage with your main-hand and Fire damage with your off-hand.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 20, '50% Weapon Damage plus 6 to up to 5 enemies within 5 yds. Your main-hand strike will deal Physical damage and your off-hand strike will deal Fire damage.'

abilities.name: Devotion of Radiance
abilities.description: Place a Devotion on the friendly target, increasing their Spell Power. Only one Devotion per Sun Cleric active at a time.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 28, '+28 Spell Power.' Part of the Devotion family.

abilities.name: Vow of Dawn
abilities.description: Direct ability damage or healing generates Solar Power and bounces to nearby targets for reduced value. Fulfillment doubles the amount of targets struck. Only 1 Vow active at a time.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: '1 Solar Power and bounces to 2 additional nearby targets with less value per target struck. Fulfillment: Doubles the amount of targets struck.' Part of the Vow family.

abilities.name: Gavel of Wrath
abilities.description: Smash an enemy for weapon damage and dispel a beneficial magic effect from them. Shares a cooldown with other Gavels.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 26, '100% Weapon Damage plus 45 and dispel 1 beneficial magic effect from them.' Part of the shared-cooldown Gavel family (Grace/Wrath/Light).

abilities.name: Sunslam
abilities.description: Slam an enemy repeatedly with the might of the sun, dealing Holy damage and stunning them each hit. Only usable while Dawn is active. Usable while moving.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 26, 'dealing 47 Holy damage and stunning them for 1 sec. Lasts 4 sec. Only usable while Dawn is active. Usable while moving.'

abilities.name: Devotion of Emperors
abilities.description: Place a Devotion on the friendly target, increasing their total stats. Only one Devotion per Sun Cleric active at a time.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 44, 3 Mana, instant, '+10% total stats. Lasts 30 min.' Part of the Devotion family.

abilities.name: Vow of the Eclipse
abilities.description: Direct ability damage or effective healing generates Solar Power and burns for a percentage of the amount over time, stacking. Fulfillment increases damage or healing done to affected targets. Only 1 Vow active at a time.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: 9 Mana, instant, 'generates 1 Solar Power and burns for 5% of the damage or healing done every 3 sec for 18 sec. Each trigger increases the damage of this effect. Fulfillment: Direct ability damage or healing done by you is increased by 10% on targets affected by Vow of the Eclipse.' Part of the Vow family.

abilities.name: Dawnsear
abilities.description: Blast an enemy with burning light.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 18, '114 Fire damage.' Piety's real Sunset-side primary nuke.

abilities.name: Rapture
abilities.description: Call down a streak of sunlight to smite your target, piercing all immunities and dealing less damage per enemy struck.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 22, '144 Fire damage to them and nearby enemies, piercing all immunities, but dealing less damage with each enemy struck.'

abilities.name: Radiant Flame
abilities.description: A channeled repeating Holyflame damage spell.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 20, '44 Holyflame Damage, repeating every 1 sec for 4 sec.' Piety's sustained-damage channel.

abilities.name: Sun Gate
abilities.description: A forward blink that removes root effects and leaves a gate allies can use once.
abilities._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Forward blink, removes root; leaves a gate allies can use once.' Real numbers not confirmed via a dedicated screenshot.

abilities.name: Daybreak
abilities.description: Make a prayer, healing an ally.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 24, '2 Charges, 10 sec recharge, healing an ally for 273.'

abilities.name: Bless
abilities.description: Place a heal-over-time on an ally, unlocking the Blessing spell family for them. Only one Bless active at a time.
abilities._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'HoT on an ally, one target at a time.' Real numbers not confirmed via a dedicated screenshot.

abilities.name: Blessing of Purity
abilities.description: The Blessed ally becomes immune to all damage for a window, but their own damage and healing done is reduced. Only usable on the Blessed ally.
abilities._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Blessed ally immune to all damage for a window, but their own damage+healing reduced. Only on Blessed ally.'

abilities.name: Blessing of Retribution
abilities.description: Deflect the next harmful spell cast on the Blessed ally within a window.
abilities._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Deflects the next harmful spell on Blessed ally within a window. Only on Blessed ally.'

abilities.name: Blessing of Triumph
abilities.description: The Blessed ally gains Haste and damage. If they drop below 35% health while active, they heal for a percentage of direct damage dealt for the remainder.
abilities._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Blessed ally: +haste, +damage; if they drop below 35%, heals them for % of direct damage dealt for remainder. Only on Blessed ally.'

abilities.name: Blessing of Absolution
abilities.description: Empower a Blessed ally to unleash a burst of holy energy in a frontal cone, generating additional threat. Only usable on your ally with Bless active.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 22, '66 Holy damage to enemies in a 10 yd frontal cone and generating additional threat.'

abilities.name: Radiant Cascade
abilities.description: Refract light into a restorative beam, healing an ally, then jumping to additional allies for reduced value.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 30, 'healing an ally for 207, and then jumps to up to 4 additional allies, healing for less with each bounce.'

abilities.name: Sunshine
abilities.description: A heal-over-time on an ally.
abilities._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Ally HoT.' Real numbers not confirmed via a dedicated screenshot.

abilities.name: Revivify
abilities.description: Battle-resurrect a fallen ally. Usable only out of combat.
abilities._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Battle-rez. Out of combat.'

abilities.name: Glorious Execution
abilities.description: Strike with both weapons, regenerating mana equal to a percentage of the damage dealt.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 20, 'Weapon Damage plus 13 Physical damage and regenerate mana equal to 5% of the damage dealt.'

abilities.name: Champion of the Sun
abilities.description: Empower your autoattacks with bonus Holy damage for a window.
abilities._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Boosts auto attacks with bonus Holy damage, for a window.' Real numbers not confirmed via a dedicated screenshot.

abilities.name: March of the Valkyr
abilities.description: Grant the party and raid a damage buff, and increase your parry chance. Does not stack with similar effects.
abilities._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Party/raid damage buff (no stacking with similar); boosts your parry chance.' Real numbers not confirmed via a dedicated screenshot.

abilities.name: Valkyr's Calling
abilities.description: Leap at a target, immune to physical and spell damage during flight, then land dealing AoE Holy damage.
abilities._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Leaps at a target, immune to physical + spell during flight; lands for AoE Holy damage.' Real numbers not confirmed via a dedicated screenshot.

abilities.name: Scrying Orb
abilities.description: Summon a controllable scrying orb for reconnaissance.
abilities._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Summons a controllable scrying orb.' Utility, not combat-relevant.

abilities.name: Gavel of Light
abilities.description: Smash an enemy and heal yourself for a percentage of the damage dealt. Shares a cooldown with other Gavels.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 4, '100% Weapon Damage plus 12 and heal yourself equal to 50% of the damage dealt.'

abilities.name: Seraphic Bulwark
abilities.description: Increase block value for a number of blocks or a duration.
abilities._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: '2 charges, 25-sec recharge. Boosts block value for a number of blocks or duration.'

abilities.name: Scroll of Hope
abilities.description: Reduce party and raid Magic damage taken. Anyone below 35% health during it receives a one-time heal.
abilities._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Reduces party/raid Magic damage taken; anyone below 35% health during it gets a one-time heal.'

abilities.name: Justicar's Wrath
abilities.description: High-threat Holy damage that increases the target's spell damage taken.
abilities._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'High-threat Holy damage + boosts target's spell damage taken.' Real numbers not confirmed via a dedicated screenshot.

abilities.name: Dawnbreak
abilities.description: Bring down the light of An'she at the target location for a duration. Allies inside receive increased healing, enemies inside take increased damage and periodic Solar Flare.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: 15 Mana, 30yd, 2 min cooldown, 'While inside, allies receive 15% increased healing from all sources and enemies take 15% increased damage from you and are struck by a Solar Flare every 1 sec.' Note: this class-wide entry is identical to Piety's shared Dawnfall - separate ability_id since Seraphim's own tree unlocks a talent-tier version.

abilities.name: Hammer of Kings
abilities.description: An encircling aura that repeatedly deals Holyfire damage to nearby enemies.
abilities._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Encircling aura: repeating Holyfire damage to nearby enemies.' Real numbers not confirmed via a dedicated screenshot.

abilities.name: Solar Nova
abilities.description: Emit a powerful holy light, damaging nearby enemies. Reduces Solar Invocation cooldown per target struck. Guaranteed critical strike against Undead or Demons.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: 15 Mana, instant, 20 sec cooldown, '168 Holy damage to all nearby enemies. Reduces the cooldown of your Solar Invocation spells by 1 sec for each target struck. Guaranteed to critically strike against Undead or Demons.'

abilities.name: Injunction
abilities.description: Taunt a target enemy.
abilities._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Taunts a target.' Real numbers not confirmed via a dedicated screenshot.
